svg.aria-label: Qualitative comparison of embedded ML platforms — microcontroller, microcontroller with NPU, DSP, mobile SoC with NPU, embedded GPU, FPGA, edge ASIC, and analog or neuromorphic — on energy efficiency, flexibility, toolchain maturity, unit cost, latency determinism and peak throughput, rated one to five
svg.text: five dots = best on that axis · a teaching judgement, not a measurement
Read down a column to see why there is no single "best" platform: each axis is won by a different row.
